items.title: Agentic Smart Payment Routing with MongoDB / Part I: The Multi-Modal Blueprint
items.summary: Transaction routing is a delicate balancing act between authorization rates, execution cost, and latency. A declined transaction can mean a lost sale, making payment optimization one of the most direct levers for top-line revenue growth. Yet payment operations teams remain trapped in manual operational cycles: Pulling batch CSV reports, analyzing spreadsheets, and manually updating rule tables in legacy gateways. And that repetitive cycle can cost you dearly.
